test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

We should help each other to make __a society that will be not concerned with any particular religious doctrines__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "a society that will be not concerned with any particular religious doctrines" can be concisely expressed.
 
• The term "secular" precisely captures the intended meaning of being unconcerned with religious doctrines.
 
• "Secular" means not connected with religious or spiritual matters, making it the most suitable substitution.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We should help each other to make a secular society that will be not concerned with any particular religious doctrines."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **B: "a prejudiced society" **– This option is incorrect because "prejudiced" implies bias, which is not the intended meaning.
 
• **C: "a harmonious society" **– While "harmonious" indicates peace, it does not specifically address the aspect of religious neutrality.
 
• **D: "a humanist society" **– "Humanist" focuses on human values and interests, which is not the precise context needed here.
